failure_modes: Loving the goal instead of what it was for
Reaching the goal and having nothing left
gloss: A wrong goal defeats correct execution; choosing the goal is the highest-leverage decision
invariants: Underestimated effort and unexamined desire are the common causes of failure
mechanism: Effort applied faithfully to the wrong goal ends in the wrong place, so the goal must be examined before any action. Goals often reflect inherited desires, insecurity, or a story about what one deserves rather than what one wants. A goal aligned with what is actually wanted takes less effort to maintain.
